## Why

The public surface said more than the 2026-09-27 release data supports: the
home page opened with a mission paragraph before its figures, dossiers
linked a reviewed-portfolio surface that does not exist publicly, the
incompleteness banner counted only `NOT_RESEARCHED` unknowns, an empty
dossier section silently asserted absence kinds the record does not carry,
"How we know this" read site-wide totals as if they were the page's own,
"contradictions kept visible" implied a contradiction browser, the citation
block claimed "permalink"/"reproducible" before real `/s/` pins exist, the
corrections log never said when it began, the nav still offered
`/contribution-back/` and `/visual-language/` (withdrawn from the allow-list
by P34.10/C-12), and the corrections fixture pointed readers at a removed
`/visual-language/#reference-map` anchor.

## What this does

1. **Key figures first, one label per quantity (QW-9, K12b NEW-14).**
   `web/src/pages/index.astro` renders the named-denominator counts section
   *before* the mission lede; every quantity keeps exactly one label plus a
   "what this counts" denominator, and a pointer sends the reader to
   `/coverage-metrics/` for the full breakdown. The lede's claim "exactly
   which sources support or contradict every material claim" narrowed to
   "the evidence behind each published figure" (no contradiction browser
   exists — K12b NEW-17).
2. **Absent capabilities say "being built" (K14 NEW-11).** The dossier-kind
   line on `dossier/[slug]` and the dossier index now read "the
   evidence-complete reviewed-portfolio form is being built" instead of
   linking `/research-dossier/`; the task-error fallback links `/dossier/`
   instead of `/visual-language/`; the home entry-point bodies state only
   what each built surface shows; `/search/` no longer offers the
   withdrawn `/releases/` browse.
3. **"How we know this" is scope-labelled (QW-6; F-05/F-132).**
   `HowWeKnowThis.astro` prints a scope line — "Site-wide — these totals
   describe the whole published record, not this page alone." for the
   default site summary and "These totals describe this page's own
   evidence, not the whole record." for a page-supplied summary (corrections,
   research queue) — derived from whether `BaseLayout` was handed a
   page provenance or fell back to the site summary, so the two can never
   be mislabelled. Labels are corrected: "Evidence artifacts", "Claims by
   evidence tier", "Independent sources", "Evidence date range", "Rules
   applied", "Human review status". `ProvenanceSummary` gains an optional
   `denominator`, populated from the export analytics envelope
   (`getSiteProvenance` in `web/src/lib/data.ts`) and rendered as a
   "Counted against: …" line when the summary carries one.
4. **Every unknown counted (QW-7; F-100/F-136).** `dossierUnknowns` in
   `web/src/lib/dossier.ts` counts every field the page cannot answer —
   `NOT_RESEARCHED`, `NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND`, `UNRESOLVED` and bare `null`
   rows, every null action-block field — deduplicated by
   `(subject_id, predicate_id)` with the more-informative kind winning;
   withheld values are counted separately (the value exists but is not
   shown), and empty sections are counted too. The banner reads
   "This dossier has N fields with no recorded value — …" with the kind
   breakdown, the empty-section count, and the withheld note; the rendered
   JSON gains `unknown_field_count`, `unknown_fields` and
   `empty_section_count` additively (`unresearched_field_count` keeps its
   SIG-UI-012 meaning). `sectionIsEmpty`, `SECTION_ACTION_BLOCKS` and
   `NO_RECORD_IN_SIG` are shared by the page, the print export and the
   counters so page and print can never disagree; an empty section renders
   "No record in SIG." asserting **no** §9.5 kind (F-422's W0 half).
5. **Contradictions honestly scoped (K12b NEW-17 / F-22).** The coverage
   metric is labelled "recorded contradictions" with the note "This page
   shows only the recorded count; SIG does not publish a contradiction
   browser." — identical text in `corrections-methodology-fixture.ts` and
   `exports/src/exports/spine_export.py` so fixture and export agree.
   The OKC worked dossier's `sharing_partners` gap and row move from
   `NOT_RESEARCHED` to `UNRESOLVED`: a contested `shares data with` edge
   to the Oklahoma County Sheriff is recorded (`REFERENCE_GRAPH_EDGES`,
   `map-network-fixture`), so "not researched" was a false claim — F-422's
   data half stays with P34.21b (boundary recorded in the run ledger).
6. **No "permalink"/"reproducible" before pins exist (QW-5, owned).**
   `Citation.astro` reads "Link (records the as-of pair and ruleset of this
   build)"; the corrections prior-value link reads "belief {date}"; the
   watch citation-list intro, the print-page footer comment and the
   corrections/methodology/home copy drop "reproducible" and "permalink".
   `tests/unit/test_p34_11_claim_words.py` sweeps the *rendered* text of
   every public `.astro` (comments, expressions and attributes stripped)
   so the words cannot return.
7. **Corrections log start date + CC0 (QW-14).** `/corrections/` states
   "This log begins {earliest corrected_at}" — derived from the entries,
   never hand-written — and the lede names the belief date each entry
   records. `/methodology/` states the contributed-to-OSM subset is
   dual-licensed CC0-1.0 for that purpose. The `/contribution-back/` and
   `/visual-language/` nav links are removed (C-12/LATER-03 keep them off
   the allow-list — removed, not restored); the corrections fixture's
   `subject_path` now points at `/map/`.
8. **Copy batch + binding tests (B-2).** 49 agent-drafted rows
   (`HO`, `DI`, `D`, `DS`, `HW`, `CC`, `CL`, `W`, `M`, `T`, `DF`, `CM`,
   `XD`, `XC` ids) are appended to
   `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md`, all `pending` operator
   verbatim confirmation. `data-copy` attributes bind rendered text to
   rows; `tests/unit/test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` enforces the two-directional
   binding (element text = joined row texts, every row carried, literals
   present verbatim, template placeholders recorded verbatim), plus the
   withdrawn-route link sweep and the no-kind-asserted rule for empty
   sections. Rows ship only when the operator confirms them; republish #1
   (P34.17) refuses a `pending` row.

## Test plan

- `web/tests/unit/dossier.test.ts` — `dossierUnknowns` kind breakdown and
  dedup over the worked fixture (2 NR / 1 NEF / 2 UNRESOLVED / 2 bare
  unknown = 7), empty-section detection, action-block nulls counted, the
  additive JSON fields, and the no-kind assertion on `NO_RECORD_IN_SIG`.
- `web/tests/unit/data.test.ts` — the site provenance carries the
  analytics envelope's denominator through in export mode.
- `tests/unit/test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` — sha256/status well-formedness,
  element↔row binding in both directions, literal-presence rows, the
  log-start derivation, the withdrawn-route link sweep, the no-kind rule.
- `tests/unit/test_p34_11_claim_words.py` — rendered-text scan for
  "permalink"/"reproducible" across every public `.astro`.
- `web/tests/e2e` — banner text/attrs, the "recorded contradictions" metric
  + no-browser note, the corrections log-start element, `TASK_PAGE` slug
  re-encoded for the `UNRESOLVED` kind.

## Boundaries / notes

- **F-422 split.** W0 half done: empty sections stop asserting an absence
  kind ("No record in SIG."), and the worked OKC record's
  `sharing_partners` is `UNRESOLVED` (the contested edge exists). The
  deeper half — a `coverage_record` asserting `sharing_partners` for a
  jurisdiction whose record holds agency-level sharing claims — is spine
  data owned by P34.21b's re-materialization + re-export, not rewritable
  from web code without inventing facts.
- **No production mutation.** The withdrawn routes stay off the public
  nav; `ops/public_routes.toml` is untouched; nothing publishes.
- **Copy status.** Every new sentence is `pending` in batch-01 — under
  B-2 only `confirmed` copy ships, so P34.17's republish #1 is gated on
  the operator's verbatim confirmation sitting.
